microAvispas.label: Project
microAvispas.title: Micro Wasps
microAvispas.subtitle: PhD research by biologist Rebeca Mora Castro
microAvispas.body: The project focused on filling information gaps regarding the biophysics of several genera of micro wasps. The experimentation investigated aspects of color and patterns on the wasp's body, the function of the color pattern, and described the microstructure of certain body parts of these insects.

intro.title: What are they?
intro.body: Micro wasps of the family Platygastridae are a group of small wasps whose life cycle mostly unfolds inside the eggs of other insects and spiders, killing them in the process. They are beneficial insects, essential to the natural balance and to pest control in agriculture.
